questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Jubilant
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. 'Overjoyed'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jubilant (आनंदित) **- Feeling or expressing great happiness and triumph.

 
 
• **Example:** The team was jubilant after their unexpected victory.
 
 
 
• **Overjoyed (अत्यन्त प्रसन्न)** - Extremely happy.
 
 
• **Example: **She was overjoyed to hear the news of her promotion.
 
 
 
• Hence, 'Overjoyed' is the synonym of the given word 'Jubilant'.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Overjoyed'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Terrified (डराहट युक्त) **- Extremely frightened.

 
 
• **Example: **He was terrified of heights and avoided tall buildings.
 
 
 
• **Journeyed (यात्रा की) **- Traveled somewhere.
 
 
• **Example: **They journeyed all through the mountains to reach the shrine.
 
 
 
• **Stunted (विकास-विरुद्ध)** - Having been prevented from growing or developing properly.
 
 
• **Example: **The drought has stunted the growth of crops this year.

questions.question:

TENDER
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "delicate"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's understand the meaning of the given words.
 
• **Tender: **__This word can mean delicate, gentle, or easily damaged(नाज़ुक).
 __
 
• *For example, *"The tender petals of the flower were easily crushed." It can also mean an offer or proposal, as in "The company submitted a tender for the construction project."
 
 
 
• **Delicate:**__ This word means fragile or easily damaged, often used to describe things that require careful handling( नाजुक).
 __
 
• *For example,* "The delicate glass figurine had to be wrapped carefully before packing it for shipping." It can also refer to something subtle or nuanced, as in "The delicate flavors of the dish were enhanced by the chef's careful seasoning."
 
 
 
• Thus, as per the above explanation, it is clear that the most appropriate synonym of the given word is **"delicate".**

***Correct answer: ***__Delicate

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Sturdy: **__This word means strong and well-built, able to withstand stress or wear(मजबूत).

 __
 
• For example, "The sturdy oak table could hold a lot of weight without wobbling."
 
 
 
• **Robust:**__ This word means strong and healthy, characterized by strength and vigor(मजबूत).
 __
 
• For example, "The robust athlete was able to run a marathon without getting tired."
 
 
 
• **Durable:**__ This word means able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage over time(टिकाऊ).
 
 
• For example, "The durable backpack was able to withstand years of use without tearing or breaking."

questions.question:
Directions: Each item in this section consists of a sentence with an underlined word followed by four words/group of words. Select the option that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the answer sheet accordingly.

Syam does not __intervene__ in others’ affairs.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Meddle**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Intervene **means to involve oneself in a situation where one is not wanted or invited. (अपने आप को ऐसी स्थिति में शामिल करना जहां कोई वांछित या आमंत्रित नहीं है)

 
 
• **Example**:* The teacher had to intervene to stop the argument between the students.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Meddle **means to interfere in someone else's business or affairs without being asked or invited. (बिना पूछे या आमंत्रित किए किसी दूसरे के व्यवसाय या मामलों में हस्तक्षेप करना)
 
 
• **Example**: *It's best not to meddle in other people's personal affairs without their consent.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, 'meddle' is the most appropriate synonym for 'intervene' in this sentence.

Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Speak **means to say something or express one's thoughts or opinions. (कुछ कहना या अपने विचार या राय व्यक्त करना)
 
• **Trouble **means to cause problems or difficulties for someone. (किसी के लिए समस्याएँ या कठिनाइयाँ पैदा करना)
 
• **Help **means to assist or support someone in need. (किसी जरूरतमंद की सहायता या समर्थन करना)

questions.question:
Directions: Each item in this section consists of a sentence with an underlined word followed by four words/groups of words. Select the option that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the Answer Sheet accordingly.

The medicine had an __immediate __effect on the patient's condition.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"immediate"** means something that happens or is done at once; instant. (तत्काल)

 
 
• **Example:** The company took immediate action to address the complaint.
 
 
 
• **"Sudden"** refers to something happening quickly and unexpectedly. (अचानक)
 
 
• **Example:** The sudden rainstorm caught everyone by surprise.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Delayed** (विलंबित): Happening at a later time than expected or intended.

 
 
• **Example:** The flight was delayed due to bad weather.
 
 
 
• **Gradual** (क्रमिक): Taking place or progressing slowly or by degrees.
 
 
• **Example:** The gradual increase in temperature was barely noticeable.
 
 
 
• **Ineffective** (अप्रभावी): Not producing any significant or desired effect.
 
 
• **Example:** The medicine was ineffective in treating the patient's symptoms.
